title: Cauliflower, frozen, cooked with butter or margarine

content.title: About
content.content: Frozen cauliflower cooked with butter or margarine is a ready‑to‑eat vegetable product that is blanched, flash‑frozen and then sautéed or stewed in fat. It retains most of its nutrients, has a mild buttery flavor and a tender texture.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Cauliflower belongs to the cruciferous family, along with broccoli and Brussels sprouts.
Freezing after blanching preserves the bright white color and crisp structure.
Cooking with butter or margarine enhances absorption of fat‑soluble vitamins A and K.
Frozen vegetables are widely used in restaurants for quick meal preparation.
Cauliflower is rich in glucosinolates, compounds that may have anti‑cancer properties.

items.title: Rich in vitamin C
items.content: Vitamin C supports the immune system and aids collagen synthesis.

items.title: Contains vitamin K
items.content: Vitamin K is essential for blood clotting and bone health.

items.title: Good source of dietary fiber
items.content: Fiber promotes healthy digestion and helps maintain satiety.

items.title: Low in calories
items.content: One cup provides about 70 kcal, making it suitable for weight‑controlled diets.

items.title: Contains antioxidants
items.content: Phytonutrients help protect cells from oxidative stress.

items.title: Cruciferous allergy
items.content: A small number of people may experience an allergic reaction to cauliflower.

items.title: Sodium content
items.content: Some versions are salted; those monitoring sodium should check the label.

items.title: Added fats
items.content: Using a lot of butter or margarine increases the product’s calorie density.

items.title: Thyroid considerations
items.content: Cauliflower contains goitrogens, which in excess may affect thyroid function.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Heat the product in a skillet or microwave, season to taste. It works well as a side dish, in soups, stews, pasta, or mixed vegetable medleys.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Keep the frozen cauliflower in a freezer at –18 °C. After thawing, use within 2–3 days and store in an airtight container in the refrigerator.
